about: How a car's progress is read from its timing points (docs/adr/0004). Run by BOTH the backend (ProgressTimelineContractTest) and the frontend (src/replay/progress.test.ts), so the replay in the browser and the server's frames always agree. t is milliseconds; laps is laps done (9.25 = a quarter of the way round lap 10).

cases.name: one lap with its sector ends
a car that stopped (retired) stays where it stopped
a missing sector: interpolated across the whole lap
